title: Gene differential expression in ventricular cardiac myocytes from right ventricle in heart failure vs. non-heart failure (Tucciarone et al. 2024)
bodyHtml:
The plot and table display gene differential expression, as determined by scRNA-seq, in right ventricle ventricular cardiac myocytes from individuals with heart failure vs. individuals without heart failure (Luca Tucciarone et al., University of California San Diego, 2024, unpublished). This work was supported by the Foundation for the National Institutes of Health.

Only genes with adjusted p-value < 0.1 are shown here. Complete data are represented in the dataset DSR264ZTQ at the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas.
